areas.label: Passenger cabin
areas.desc: The stern cabin where the party bunks. Master Ozhra's charts and the (missing) colours chest.

areas.label: Quarterdeck and wheel
areas.desc: Ozhra at the wheel. First place Redsail's boarders aim for.

areas.label: Main deck
areas.desc: Grain hatches and the guns. The poacher fight happens here.

areas.label: Forecastle
areas.desc: Bow deck; good ground for ranged PCs.

areas.label: Bowsprit
areas.desc: A narrow perch over the water.

areas.label: Port water: Redsail's ship comes alongside
areas.desc: Boarding lines and planks come over the rail from here. (Second ship: a second Schooner scene or token.)

areas.label: Starboard water: Ninehulls' broadside
areas.desc: Where Ninehulls' fleet comes out of; the cannonade lands on the poachers.
